notes.title: Huge bug fixes
notes.notes:
As some players may have experienced some bugs, I went and rushed to fix them:
- The reset button now refunds the full amount of money
- The enemies now don't get stuck on each other
- Made xp give more well xp
- Some other minor bugs

Thanks y'all for playing !!!
Don't forget to review !!

notes.title: Game Release !
notes.notes:
[p][b]BloodBound Knights[/b] will be launching the [b]26th of July[/b], so very soon ! I'm very happy to see this finally coming to life, I've spent countless days working on this project (almost 2 years !) and I'm very proud of what the game looks like today, and I hope you guys do too ![/p][p]I'm wishing you guys love the game and play it, to create a strong community around it ! 
The game will be launching with a discounted price of more or less [u]4.50€[/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Thanks for everyone who supported me throughout the whole project, and have a nice game time ![/b][/p]
